preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 3000.
For each test case, n must be between 1 and 1000, and k1 and k2 must be between 0 and n.
The number of white dominoes w and black dominoes b must be between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.
The number of white dominoes w must not exceed the available white cells, and the number of black dominoes b must not exceed the available black cells.
